cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Fair Means I Can Win
cards.instruction: Agree to any rule or bargain only after interpreting fairness in a way that preserves your advantage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A fair race gives me a head start. I've had a tiring morning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll mark out the start. Mine needs a little compensation for the stairs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We start on the same line.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll draw one continuous line. Check it yourself; it just bends forward where I stand.
